name: Egbere (Lost Atlanteans)
body:
Egbere CR 6

A pouting, child-sized creature wanders the jungle at night clutching a rolled up woven mat.

XP 2,400
CE Small undead
Init +2; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +10
Aura aura of gloom (30 ft., DC 17)

DEFENSE

AC 19, touch 14, flat-footed 16 (+2 Dex, +1 dodge, +5 natural, +1 size)
hp 79 (8d8+43)
Fort +6, Ref +4, Will +7
DR 5/magic; Immune undead traits

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft.
Melee touch of death +12 touch (1d8+6 negative energy)
Space 5 ft.; Reach 5 ft.
Special Attacks touch of death, silent cry
Spell-Like Abilities (Cl 6th; concentration +10)

3/day—demand offering, doom, pilfering hand
1/day—crushing despair

STATISTICS

Str 22, Dex 14, Con —, Int 13, Wis 11, Cha 18
Base Atk +5; CMB +10 (+12 steal); CMD 22 (24 steal)
Feats Combat Expertise, Dodge, Improved Steal, Iron Will
Skills Climb +11, Intimidate +14, Knowledge (arcana) +8, Knowledge (religion) +8, Perception +10, Sense Motive +7, Stealth +16 (includes +4 size bonus)
Languages Common, Necril
Sq death wail, wealth scent

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Aura Of Gloom (Su)

An egbere is surrounded by an aura of despair and discontent. The first time a creature enters this aura, they must make a DC 17 Will saving throw. On a failed save, a creature can’t benefit from morale bonuses and takes a -1 penalty on Will saving throws against spells with the emotion descriptor for the next 10 minutes. Any creature that successfully saves against this aura gains immunity to it for the next 24 hours. This is a mind-affecting emotion effect. The save DC is Charisma-based.

Death Wail (Su)

When an egbere dies, a wail like that of millions of sad souls fills a 60 foot radius around the egbere. Any creature within the radius must make a DC 17 Fortitude save. On a failed save, a creature takes 6d6 sonic damage and gains the deafened condition (until cured). On a successful save, a creature takes half damage and is not deafened.

Silent Cry (Su)

As a swift action, an egbere can select one creature within 30 feet and fill its mind with an agonizing cry that only it can hear. The target must make a DC 17 Fortitude save. On a failed save, the target takes 1d8 sonic damage and is stunned for 1 round. On a successful save, the target takes half damage and is not stunned.

Wealth Scent (Ex)

An egbere gains the scent ability, but only to detect objects whose value is at least 2,000 gold pieces or more. The egbere treats all magical items as overpowering scents.

ECOLOGY

Environment warm forests (jungle)
Organization solitary
Treasure double standard

When an orphaned, humanoid child dies a solitary and impoverished death, it returns as an undead egbere determined to take revenge on those who have plenty, something it never had in life. An egbere wears a skirt of woven palm fronds with an animal skin tunic. With the hood of its tunic pulled up over its head and its jet black skin, an egbere fades into the night’s darkness to prowl for valuables to steal.

Every egbere carries a rolled up mat in its hands which is its most cherished possession. Whenever an egbere obtains a valuable item from one of its victims, it stashes the item in its mat (which, while the egbere exists, can magically hold an unlimited amount of objects). Upon the egbere’s demise, the mat unrolls (the only way for anyone other than the egbere to access the mat’s contents), expelling all the objects stored within before the mat unravels, leaving tiny threads of fiber drifting away into the jungle underbrush.

Lost Atlanteans, Copyright 2024, Bloodstone Press; author Beth Jones
